description: Get the locked price quote for registering a domain: wholesale plus the itemized 1% platform cut, printed plainly as wholesaleCents, platformCutCents, platformCutBasisPoints, and totalCents. Read-only, no API key needed: this uses the public endpoint, so any agent can try it with zero signup. Nothing is purchased.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name, e.g. example.com
